title: Compliance odd-jobs list (morning hub)
content:
Morning scratchpad: quick hub for the weird little clearance tasks I keep postponing. Not a formal ticket list — notes to myself with links and mini-actions.

Context: sprint ends Friday; need to finish a handful of evidence items for sysadmin access review plus vendor risk follow-ups. I have ~3h this morning to knock out as many of these as possible before the SRE sync.

Top priority (finish today if possible)
- [ ] SOC2: gather 2024-2026 admin account change log exports (Azure AD + Okta). Confluence index says page under "SOC2 Evidence Index" — start with SEC Evidence Index -> link (see linked_artifacts). Quick command to run: export from Okta Admin Console -> Reports -> System Log (filter: eventType eq "user.lifecycle.update"). If missing events, ask SRE to forward cloudtrail subset (ticket: JIRA-SEC-4123).
- [ ] Vendor: TinyVault (KMS) re-eval — I have last vendor questionnaire attached in GH PR #987 (notes in PR). Need to confirm: do they have quarterly penetration testing report (redacted) for 2026? If not, mark residual risk and escalate to Lisa (GTM security).
- [ ] Policy TODO: update "Privileged Access" draft with bifurcation for Dedicated customers (on-prem/air-gapped nuance). Quick diff: copy old doc -> add section "VPC & Dedicated: key rotation responsibilities". Tag infra folks.

Secondary (stretch goals)
- [ ] Evidence pairing: map each control to one audit artifact (start with CC6.1-CC6.5). Create mini-sheet: control -> artifact -> owner -> status. I can bootstrap with three: MFA enforcement, Admin account audit, KMS key policy. If time, email owners with short one-liner asking for final file.
- [ ] Vendor: schedule 30m call with TinyVault (or their security rep) next week; propose Tue morning slot. Prepare 3 questions: pentest cadence, encryption in transit details, customer-side key management boundaries.

Short notes / odd jobs to clear
- Quick grep in S3 bucket: need to confirm if backup bucket has public ACLs (use aws s3api get-bucket-acl). Ask infra to run with me if I hit permission wall.
- Confirm snapshot retention policy for Dedicated: Confluence doc had conflicting numbers (30 vs 90 days). Find latest PR that changed retention and get owner.
- Audit log tagging: some entries lack "customer_id" tag in our tracing pipeline -> file a ticket in INF with example log lines.

Meeting prep (SRE sync in 10:00)
- Bring up: missing Okta events (JIRA-SEC-4123), TinyVault follow-up, retention discrepancy.
- Ask for 15m after sync to pair on Okta export if available.

Random thoughts / future items (brain dump)
- Could we automate evidence mapping with a one-page script that crawls Confluence, our S3 evidence bucket, and GitHub to find candidate artifacts? Prototype idea: python script -> outputs CSV. Save for next sprint or Hack Day.
- Consider marking low-risk vendors as "re-check bi-annually" vs quarterly to reduce churn for tiny OSS vendors where data access is minimal. Need to write decision rubric.

Quick checklist I can close in 3h: (goal: close at least 2)
1) Okta export for admin changes -> attach to Confluence.
2) TinyVault quick risk note -> slack Lisa and create vendor ticket.
3) Update Privileged Access draft: add Dedicated paragraph + assign owner.
4) File INF ticket for missing log tags (if I find sample).

Notes to self about phrasing when contacting owners:
- Short subject lines: "Evidence request: Okta admin-change export (SOC2)"
- Attach a one-line reason + what I need (file + format) + deadline (EOD Thursday).

Open questions (need answers before Friday)
- Does TinyVault have a 2026 pentest report? (if no -> residual risk note)
- Which infra config PR changed Dedicated snapshot retention? (link?)
- Can we automate the prefix filtering for KV cache logs so I can extract trace examples easier?

End-of-day wrap plan (tomorrow)
- Consolidate evidence attachments to one Confluence page, label by control, ping auditor.
- Draft vendor risk memo for TinyVault if they cannot provide pentest proof.
- Follow up with SRE on missing Okta events and request a short example export.

Tiny snippets of commands I often forget (save here):
- Okta system log export: Settings -> Reports -> System Log -> Filter: eventType eq "user.lifecycle.update" -> Export CSV
- AWS ACL quick check: aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-evidence-backups
- List KMS keys (aws): aws kms list-keys --profile prod | jq '.'

Finished? aim = 3 items checked. If I only get 1, ship it with clear follow-ups.
